rule: English dialogue and voice-over; every line AI-generated with seed_audio inside the account, then uploaded into the submission project

S1.line: It would not be the last tragedy to strike this world. The final act was waiting — on the release of the Vesper.

S2.line: Are you sure you're not God?
To a firefly, the eagle is a god. To the minnow, the whale. The word only means a power beyond the place you stand.

S3.line: Why release him again, if we know he could annihilate everything?
There must be risk if there is to be growth.

S4.line: He could erase everything. Even the planets before this one. Even Earth.

S5.line: But I'm terrified I cannot see the end.
So it must be. Leave the whys to me, child. That is trust.

S15.line: Do you really think we can make it the whole way?
Since when do we care about stuff like that?

S22.line: Did you know they could do this? Imagine if we both made it in —
I want to move mountains. To raise them over the heads of my enemies.

S23.line: There must be risk if there is to be growth.

voice._how: seed_audio (ByteDance) at 0.1 credits a line — voice is the cheapest thing in this production. Generated inside the account, which is what the rule requires; every file still has to be uploaded into the submission project at RUN 31.

casting_test._listen: Two candidates per character, same line. Pick one, write it into `cast` below, then generate the full cut.

ORIANE.direction: Movement I is fear, not fatigue — she is young and arguing and losing. Her closing voice-over is the opposite: spoken after the battle that kills her, tired to the bone and still unbroken. Slow it and drop the level; never soften the spine.

voice.note: Caedom must sound older than Oriane and calmer than everything around him; Alder must read a shade colder than Wren, because the last line of the film is his.
